additional_fixes: Disabled transparent buttons preserve original alpha instead of becoming opaque grey.
Windows named-pipe opening waits up to the existing 2-second connection timeout for a free instance. Commands already sent are not retried.
initial_failure_evidence: selection-100.json: server stalled during probing; fixture subsequently gained HEAD/Range support.
selection-final-100.json: test confused the global TVBox entry with the selected-task entry; assertion corrected.
selection-diagnostic.json: batch resume failed with Windows pipe instances busy; diagnostic captured before transport correction.

selection-fixed-100.json: a fixture that deliberately stopped sending bytes did not resume within the test deadline of 15 seconds. The final normal-flow tests use a continuously throttled transfer. This stalled-network case is not claimed as passed.

selection-flowing-150-final-layout.png: initial guest desktop too small; top controls fit but bottom was clipped. Superseded by full-viewport display runs with whole-window bounds and bottom status text verified.
limits: UI scaling was set using the Java UI scale; Windows OS display settings were not changed.
No physical casting/TVBox device or cloud subtitle acceptance was performed.
No host installation, signing, installer update, commit, push or GitHub release was performed.
Java Access Bridge emitted a dynamic-tree IndexOutOfBoundsException during reads; both final functional runs completed successfully.

stalled_network_followup.scope: Direct HTTP response reads; original failure entry retained as history.
